identity_rules.authority: AUTHORITY_IDENTITY from verified semantic authority_id body; distinct from raw authority-file digest
identity_rules.binding: not projected or synthesized; absent bindings stay absent
identity_rules.graph: CONTENT_IDENTITY over supplied graph bytes, checked against profile pin
identity_rules.invocation: INSTANCE_IDENTITY string in candidate.identity after canonical candidate verification
identity_rules.ledger: not projected by these proof routes; BR-02/BR-05 remain open
identity_rules.policy: CONTRACT_CONSTANT from governing profile; not inferred from runtime
identity_rules.profile: content pin of supplied authoritative profile; never regenerated from candidate
identity_rules.proof: CONTENT_IDENTITY with O08GateProof-sha256 or O09SlotProof-sha256 namespace over canonical proof body excluding identity
identity_rules.released_profile_content: verified canonical candidate body digest; not release authority or ProgrammerProfile identity
identity_rules.runtime: exact source envelope runtime; no recomputation from other domains
identity_rules.source_artifact: CONTENT_IDENTITY over exact supplied bytes; existing independently pinned domain
identity_rules.source_content: same raw byte digest only when governing source binding explicitly uses that domain

required_trust_inputs: qualification validity view; never inferred from raw hash equality
scope: O08 and both O09 source-to-candidate routes only; no new trusted profile creation
